issues.title: Zq open login path in the auth module
issues.summary: The authentication module accepts sign-in attempts without any throttling or lockout.
issues.impact: Repeated guessing is cheap, so weak credentials can be found by an outsider in general terms.
issues.fix: Add per-account throttling and a temporary lockout to the sign-in step.
issues.detail: ZQDETAIL-1 src/auth/login.js line 31 reads SESSION_SECRET and falls back to a constant; see https://wiki.internal.example.test/auth and host 10.2.3.4.

issues.title: Zq chatty read from the shop service to the data layer
issues.summary: One user action reads the whole order collection through this edge.
issues.impact: Latency and load grow with the amount of stored data.
issues.fix: Page the read or add a summary query.
issues.detail: ZQDETAIL-2 src/index.js:3 loops over every row.
